recipes.name: Green Chicken Soup with Egg
recipes.instructions:
Place the chicken thigh in a pot of cold water and bring it to a boil.
Drain the water, cover the thigh with fresh cold water and simmer until cooked.
Remove the chicken, shred the meat and discard the skin, bones and gristle.
Add diced potato, chopped onion and grated carrot to the broth and cook.
Season with a '10 vegetables' spice blend if you like.
Add the shredded meat and diced boiled egg when the vegetables are nearly done.
Stir in thin noodles and cover for a few minutes.
Finish with chopped parsley and a spoonful of sour cream.

recipes.name: Apple Pancakes
recipes.instructions:
Peel the apple and grate it finely.
Mix in the flour, egg, sweetener and baking powder until combined.
Add a little more flour if needed so the batter holds its shape.
Shape the dough into patties or small rounds.
Fry in a dry non-stick pan or with a little butter until golden on both sides.

recipes.name: Lavash Pizza
recipes.instructions:
Cut the lavash sheet in half and place one piece in a dry pan.
Sprinkle it with 50 g of cheese and cover with the second piece.
Spread ketchup and yogurt over the top layer, then add your toppings.
Top with the remaining cheese, cover and cook over low heat until the cheese melts.

recipes.name: Egg and Cheese Salad
recipes.instructions:
Boil the eggs and chop them finely.
Grate the cheese on a fine grater.
Dice the cucumber into small cubes.
Toss everything together and season with salt and pepper to taste.

recipes.name: Quinoa Salad
recipes.instructions:
Boil the quinoa for 25 minutes, then drain.
Whisk together lemon juice and olive oil, adding salt, pepper or garlic if you like.
Dice the vegetables and toss them with the dressing and quinoa.
Add the salad leaves and mix gently.

recipes.name: Stuffed Pancakes
recipes.instructions:
Mix all the ingredients except the ham and cheese in a bowl.
Let the batter rest for about 15 minutes.
Spoon 1 tablespoon of batter onto a hot pan for each pancake.
Top each one with a slice of cheese and ham, then cover with more batter.
Cover the pan and cook over low heat until set.

recipes.name: Tuna Salad
recipes.instructions:
Drain the tuna and place it in a bowl.
Add the remaining ingredients and toss to combine.
Season to taste and serve.

recipes.name: Chicken Caesar Salad
recipes.instructions:
Cook the chicken fillet by frying or boiling it, then slice it.
Whisk lemon juice, 1 teaspoon of mustard, a clove of garlic and 1 tablespoon of olive oil into a dressing.
Chop the vegetables of your choice.
Toss the chicken and vegetables with the dressing.
Top with croutons and serve.

recipes.name: Banana Roll
recipes.instructions:
Mix the flour, egg, milk, half the cheese, sweetener and a pinch of salt.
Cook the batter into one large pancake in a lightly oiled pan for 1 to 2 minutes per side.
Spread the remaining cheese on the warm pancake, adding honey or sweetener if you like.
Place a whole banana on top and roll it up.
Slice the roll into small pieces and serve.

recipes.name: Walnut and Arugula Salad
recipes.instructions:
Arrange washed arugula on a deep plate.
Dice the cheese and tomato and scatter them over the arugula.
Boil the eggs, then halve them.
Sprinkle the salad with chopped walnuts.
Drizzle with liquid honey and oil.

recipes.name: Garlic Shrimp and Avocado Salad
recipes.instructions:
Whisk together 3-4 tablespoons olive oil, the juice of half a lemon, 1 tablespoon whole grain mustard and 1 tablespoon honey until smooth.
Sauté the shrimp in 30 g butter with 1-2 crushed garlic cloves for 1-2 minutes.
Transfer the shrimp to the bowl with the dressing and toss gently.
Peel the avocado, remove the pit, cut it into large cubes and add it to the bowl.
Tear the iceberg lettuce by hand and add it to the shrimp.
Toss gently so the dressing coats everything evenly.
Segment the grapefruit half, cut the pieces in half and add them with 1 tablespoon capers. Toss once more.

recipes.name: Creamy Cheese Soup
recipes.instructions:
Dice the onion, carrot and potato, then boil them in water for 20 minutes.
Blend everything into a smooth purée, draining off excess water if you prefer a thicker soup.
Return the purée to the heat and stir in the cream and seasonings.
Cube the cheese and add it to the pot, stirring constantly until fully melted.
Blend the soup once more before serving.

recipes.name: Thai-Style Chicken Rice
recipes.instructions:
Sauté the chicken fillet with onion and vegetables until tender.
Add the cooked rice and soy sauce.
Stir-fry everything together for 3 minutes.

recipes.name: Slow-Roasted Rosemary Wine Meat
recipes.instructions:
Place a large piece of meat in a deep, ovenproof dish with a lid.
Season with salt and pepper, scatter garlic cloves and rosemary sprigs on top, and add bay leaves.
Pour in red wine, adding a little water if the meat is not fully covered.
Cover tightly with the lid; if the dish is thin, wrap it in two or three layers of foil to trap the aromas.
Bring to a boil, then bake at 140-160°C for 4-5 hours.
The wine will soak in, leaving a sauce behind, and the finished meat will practically fall apart.

recipes.name: Pumpkin Millet Porridge
recipes.instructions:
Peel 500 g of pumpkin, remove the seeds and cut it into small, even cubes.
Rinse 200 g of millet thoroughly, then place it in a pot with 1 liter of milk, 4 tablespoons of sugar and a pinch of salt.
Heat the oven to 180°C.
Add the pumpkin cubes, 50 g butter and a cinnamon stick to the pot, then simmer over low heat for 20 minutes, stirring occasionally.
Transfer the porridge to a baking dish, remove the cinnamon stick and top with 50 g butter. Bake for 30 minutes.
Let the porridge cool slightly and serve warm. Garnish with marigold (calendula) petals for a special aroma, if desired.

recipes.name: Uzbek Plov
recipes.instructions:
Soak the rice in heavily salted water at about 60°C, made from 3 cups of boiling water and 1 cup of cold water.
Heat oil in a heavy pot and caramelize a piece of onion, then remove it.
Fry the sliced onion until golden red, then brown the meat in a single layer.
Add the carrots and cumin and fry until the carrots are soft.
Pour in boiling water and simmer gently for at least 40 minutes to make the zirvak broth.
Once the zirvak has simmered, add the garlic and pepper and season with salt.
Rinse the rice gently in warm water and spread it evenly over the carrots. Add more boiling water if needed to cover the rice, then turn the heat to maximum.
When the water has boiled away and the rice is done, shape the plov into a mound, cover with a plate and let it rest on the lowest heat for at least 40 minutes.

recipes.name: Zucchini and Spinach Fritters with Yogurt Sauce
recipes.instructions:
Grate the zucchini finely into a deep bowl.
Add a pinch of salt, stir and leave for 5-7 minutes, then squeeze out as much juice as possible.
Blend the spinach with the egg until smooth.
Combine the squeezed zucchini with the spinach mixture, flour and spices.
Heat a lightly oiled pan.
Spoon the batter into the pan and fry under a lid over medium heat for 3-4 minutes per side, flipping once and cooking 2-3 minutes more.
For the sauce, mix yogurt, finely chopped dill, pressed garlic, lemon juice and a pinch of salt.

recipes.name: Cheese Buns
recipes.instructions:
Mash the cottage cheese with the egg, blending until creamy if it is grainy. If it is wet, wrap it in cheesecloth and squeeze out the excess liquid.
Stir in the finely grated hard cheese and seasonings.
Sift the flour with baking powder and gradually mix it into the cheese, keeping the dough slightly sticky.
Wet your hands, divide the dough into 5 equal balls and place them on parchment, flattening them slightly.
Brush the tops with egg yolk or water and sprinkle with sesame seeds.
Bake at 180°C for 20-25 minutes until golden.

recipes.name: Lazy Khachapuri
recipes.instructions:
Separate one egg. In a bowl, mix the cottage cheese, egg white, flour, salt and spices.
Mash with a fork until smooth. The dough should be thick and hold its shape.
Spread the dough onto a lightly oiled, preheated non-stick pan, wetting your fingers if it sticks.
Fry under a lid over low heat for 3 to 4 minutes, until the bottom is golden.
Carefully flip the khachapuri and sprinkle grated mozzarella into the center.
Make a small well in the cheese, add the reserved yolk and cover for 1 to 2 minutes, until the cheese melts and the yolk stays runny.

recipes.name: Egg Toast
recipes.instructions:
Cut a hole in the center of two slices of bread, leaving a border about 1 cm wide.
Heat a non-stick pan with a drop of oil and toast the bread for 1 minute on each side, until lightly golden.
Crack an egg into the center of each slice and season with salt and your favorite spices.
Press the bread border down firmly so the egg does not run out.
Cover and cook over low heat until the whites are set, leaving the yolk runny if you like.
Sprinkle with grated cheese, cover again, turn off the heat and let it melt for 1 to 2 minutes.
Serve the toasts with the bread centers, toasted in the pan alongside.

recipes.name: Frittata
recipes.instructions:
Whisk the eggs with milk, salt and spices in a bowl. Do not whip into foam, just mix until smooth.
Chop the vegetables and sauté them in oil until the excess moisture evaporates.
Pour the egg mixture over the vegetables in the pan.
For the oven, bake at 180 °C for 10 to 12 minutes, until the center is springy.
On the stovetop, cover and cook over low heat for 7 to 10 minutes instead.
The frittata is ready when the edges are set and the center still wobbles slightly.

recipes.name: Armenian Eka
recipes.instructions:
Grate the cheese on a medium or large grater and finely chop the fresh herbs.
Lightly beat the egg in a small bowl with salt and pepper.
Heat a non-stick pan over medium-low heat and brush the bottom with a thin layer of oil.
Place the lavash on the warm pan and pour the egg into the center, spreading it and leaving a 2 to 3 cm border.
Quickly sprinkle with the grated cheese and herbs.
While the egg is still runny, fold the edges of the lavash into the center to form a square or triangle. The egg acts as glue.
Press gently with a spatula, cover and cook for 2 to 3 minutes.
Flip and cook for 1 to 2 minutes more, until the cheese melts and the lavash turns golden and crisp. Serve hot.

recipes.name: Ham and Cheese Muffins
recipes.instructions:
Preheat the oven to 180 °C and prepare the muffin tin with paper liners or a light coating of butter.
Dice the chicken ham and hard cheese very finely, about 3 to 4 mm, and finely chop the herbs.
Whisk the egg, sour cream and melted butter in a deep bowl until completely smooth. Make sure all ingredients are at room temperature.
Add the whole grain flour, baking powder, a pinch of salt and spices, then fold gently with a spatula.
Stir in the ham, cheese and herbs, then divide the batter among the molds, filling them no more than two-thirds full.
Bake for 18 to 22 minutes, until golden and a wooden skewer comes out dry from the center.
Let the muffins rest in the molds for 5 to 10 minutes.
Transfer to a rack to cool completely.

recipes.name: Cauliflower Cream Soup
recipes.instructions:
Soak the cashews in clean water for at least 1 to 2 hours, or overnight for best results.
Cut the cauliflower and carrot into medium pieces.
Add the vegetables with just enough water to barely cover them and cook until very soft.
Pour off some of the vegetable broth into a separate container and set it aside.
Add the soaked cashews, light cream, salt and spices to the vegetables.
Blend thoroughly with an immersion blender until completely smooth.
If the soup is too thick, gradually add back the reserved broth until you reach the desired consistency.

recipes.name: Broccoli Cream Soup
recipes.instructions:
Dice the potato, carrot and onion into small cubes. The smaller the pieces, the faster they cook.
Cover the vegetables with water, just 1 cm above them, and simmer over medium heat for 10 to 12 minutes.
Break the broccoli into small florets, add them to the pot and cook for another 5 to 7 minutes.
Add the processed cheese and stir constantly until it fully dissolves into the hot broth.
Remove from the heat, blend until perfectly smooth and season with salt, pepper and dried garlic.
If the soup is too thick, add a little hot water. Do not reboil it, so the broccoli keeps its bright green color.
Sprinkle with pumpkin seeds before serving.

recipes.name: Cheese Cream Soup
recipes.instructions:
Dice the onion and carrot finely and cut the potatoes into medium pieces. Heat half the oil in a heavy-bottomed pot.
Add the onion and carrot and sauté over medium heat for 3 to 4 minutes, until soft and lightly golden. Stir in the turmeric and heat for 30 seconds.
Add the potatoes and pour in about 200 to 250 ml of hot water, just enough to barely cover the vegetables. Season with salt, cover and simmer for 15 to 20 minutes, until the potatoes are very soft.
Meanwhile, cut the chicken fillet into small pieces, season with salt and pepper, and fry in the remaining oil until golden.
Remove the chicken from the pan. Cut the whole grain bread into cubes and toast them in a dry pan until crisp.
Stir the finely chopped garlic into the soup, remove the pot from the heat and blend until smooth.
Return the pot to low heat, add the processed cheese and whisk until melted. Pour in the cream and heat for 1 minute without boiling.
Serve topped with the fried chicken and garlic croutons.

recipes.name: Chicken and Egg Ramen
recipes.instructions:
Slice the chicken fillet thinly and place it in a pot with about 350 to 400 ml of water.
Add a crushed garlic clove and a peeled piece of ginger. Simmer for 10 to 12 minutes after boiling, skimming off the foam.
Boil the egg for 6 minutes, then transfer it to ice water. Pour boiling water over the rice noodles, let them soak for 3 to 5 minutes and drain.
Remove the ginger and garlic from the broth and stir in the soy sauce.
Divide the noodles between deep bowls, top with the chicken and pour over the hot broth.
Halve the egg, place it on top and sprinkle with sesame seeds.
